profile.headline: Software Engineer III at IDR, Inc. (on contract at Riot Games)
profile.summary: I’ve been in the games industry for over a decade and I’ve worked on games across genres, budgets, and IP. I’ve built multiplayer games from the ground up, created new and improved pipelines, and designed unforgettable gameplay moments. I’m the person people look to for solutions, guidance, and direction. I build gameplay, architect systems, I absorb software architecture like a sponge and, above all, I drag games kicking and screaming across the finish line.

positions.title: Lead Designer
positions.description:
Shipped (2026) Life is Strange: Reunion
▪️Delivered on an “impossible” production schedule, guiding designers into shipping levels and content on time by building in passes, avoiding overpolish and doing playtests to validate design hypotheses. Simplified tools and pipelines and reframed conversations into finding the fun fast.
▪️Mentored 4 designers on best practices and career/skill development; regularly ran team reviews of scenes and levels to provide feedback for iteration; performed yearly performance reviews for direct reports; regularly ran workshops on practical problem solving, debugging and gameplay/experience iteration.
▪️Led the charge in identifying cinematic narrative moments that could be reimagined as impactful gameplay instead and in iterating on this gameplay.

positions.title: Lead/Principal Programmer
positions.description:
Shipped (2024) Life is Strange: Double Exposure
▪️Developed integrated Unreal 5 automation tools that drastically accelerated cinematic production by allowing first-pass Sequencer cinematics to be generated procedurally in seconds by a cinematic artist, cutting setup time to a fraction of what it would normally be. This system was used by all cinematics artists  to produce around half of the cinematics in Life is Strange: Reunion.
▪️Leader In R&D efforts, building new in-engine C++ tools and iterating on experimental prototypes, reinventing how the studio creates cinematics and narrative gameplay; led prototyping new game systems, ability systems, AI, level design, encounter design, and modular branching cinematics.
▪️Built new game architecture and tools to enable rapid iteration across multiple systems: GAS-driven player abilities, AI frameworks, encounter design, branching cinematics. Led prototyping efforts using these systems, creating great-feeling action combat prototypes and early demos that were pitched to publishers.
▪️Collaborated to author some of the most ambitious gameplay ever achieved by the studio, such as satisfying interactive cinematic takedowns and addictive online co-operative multiplayer combat.

positions.title: Lead Programmer
positions.description:
Shipped (2021) Ruined King: A League of Legends Story
▪️On Wayfinder, drove client architecture, gameplay, and systems for GAS-driven, always-online, MMO-lite action RPG with procedural maps.
▪️On Ruined King, shipped Airship Syndicate's best performing and highest rated game to date, including simultaneous release of in-house developed Nintendo Switch version.
▪️Led teams from small prototypes to large-scale productions: 3 direct report engineers with a team of 30 in 2020, up to 12 direct report engineers on a game team of 90+ in 2022
▪️Defined long-term game architecture and development strategy, steering core technical direction across multiple project lifecycles, including low-level application architecture and engine best practices.
▪️Led architecture and networking flow for procedural generation of game worlds and events.
▪️Designed and implemented transformative gameplay features to match creative vision, such as a scalable, dynamic Utility AI system to handle hundreds of AI agents on dedicated servers, and a multi-threaded UI job system to handle complex UI sequencing that could change on-the-fly based on player options.
▪️Mentored engineers and contractors, fostering best practices and effective problem-solving strategies, improving workflows and establishing scalable engineering practices adopted studio-wide.
Oversaw builds, source control, and platform releases, managing automated systems, source control permissions, and multi-SKU deployment.
▪️Interfaced directly with publishers Riot Games and Digital Extremes to align on publisher expectations, provide solutions and technical expertise, and champion the good of the game and players.

positions.title: Senior Game Programmer
positions.description:
Shipped (2019) Darksiders Genesis
▪️Engineeed gameplay and systems such as encounters, AI, traversal, combat, hit reactions, stagger systems and UI framework, using UE4 C++ and Blueprint systems
▪️Developed flexible, designer-friendly UI framework for UMG in C++ that Airship continued to use on future projects.
▪️Owned PS4 implementation, handling title integration, certification (TRCs), testing and build management
▪️Co-developed in-house networked ability system with other gameplay developers.
▪️Owned ability, movement and combat feel and authored core AI behavior sets to apply different kinds of gameplay pressure during combat.
▪️Owned networking replication, prediction, and network traffic optimization.
▪️Maintained build systems and build pipeline.

positions.title: Game Programmer
positions.description:
Shipped (2017) Battle Chasers: Nightwar
▪️Programmed features and logic in Unity C#
▪️Developed a custom build pipeline with multi-platform support
▪️Owned UI architecture for the game and implementation of most menus and UI logic
▪️Owned localization and created a self-contained localization string system in Unity

positions.title: UI Scripter/Programmer
positions.locationName: Santa Monica, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
(2017) Uncharted 4: A Thief’s End
▪️Shipped award-winning Uncharted 4: A Thief’s End as UI Scripter/Programmer
▪️Collaborated in accessibility efforts, implementing and advocating for enhanced accessibility features
▪️Implemented HUD/menus using ActionScript 3, C++ and proprietary Racket-based language
▪️Created tools for designers to author menus and UI; optimized efficiency of game UI rendering logic
▪️Implemented localization support and glyph generation

projects.title: Life is Strange: Reunion
projects.description: A cinematic narrative adventure game by Deck Nine Games. The saga of Max and Chloe, and the fate of Caledon, is yours to decide! Play as both Max and Chloe as an all-new story builds towards an epic climax. The fire will force Max and Chloe to make devastating decisions. Can they find a future together… Before everything burns?

projects.title: Life is Strange: Double Exposure
projects.description: A cinematic narrative adventure game by Deck Nine Games. When Max Caulfield finds her friend Safi dead in the snow, she tears open the way to a parallel timeline. Here, Safi is still alive - and still in danger! With her new power to Shift between two timelines – can Max solve and prevent the same murder?
